title: GatePrepareApproval
description: Response of prepare (#15 issueNonce, consumed by #32 prepareApproval). Every call issues a fresh nonce and invalidates the previous one. The challenge is not part of the response: the device builds it from payloadHash, intentId and nonce, and its byte encoding is an open question.

payload.description: The stored canonical payload, the exact JCS string the card is rendered from and the hash covers (UTF-8).

payloadHash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 the gate computed over the stored canonical payload.

nonce.description: Single-use nonce: 32 random bytes as unpadded base64url.

items.title: GateContextSource
items.description: A linked source shown as Context used.
